10.1063/5.0342298.note_en: A branching-process and percolation framework relates adaptive vigilance and network clustering to epidemic invasion and final size.
10.1063/5.0342298.note_zh: 分枝过程与渗流框架联系行为警觉适应、网络聚类和疫情入侵及最终规模。

10.1063/5.0343851.note_zh: 二阶忆阻突触在脉冲神经元环中产生随耦合变化的同步及类奇美拉态。

10.1063/5.0346196.note_zh: 在度均匀平均场近似下，高阶传播产生阈下双稳态并改变疫情吸引域。

10.1063/5.0349743.note_en: Two coupled bistable oscillators exhibit symmetry-breaking periodic states, phase locking and amplitude death across coupling and detuning regimes.

10.1063/5.0349918.note_en: Nonlocal nonlinear evolution of pairwise dissimilarities drives a hierarchical hyperedge-merging procedure for hypergraph clustering.

10.1063/5.0350813.note_zh: 合并随机游走刻画网络公共品博弈中举报策略及制度激励的弱选择条件。

10.1063/5.0351153.note_en: Dual reinforcement-learning values balance immediate payoffs and delayed neighborhood welfare to support cooperation in spatial public goods games.
10.1063/5.0351153.note_zh: 双重强化学习价值协调即时个人收益与延迟邻域福利，调节空间公共品博弈中的合作。

10.1063/5.0351165.note_zh: 演化中的社会纽带与帮助响应形成反馈，在嵌套互动群体中维持合作。

10.1103/81gf-mlhm.note_en: Community overlap and group size determine conditions for cooperation to spread across community-structured networks.

10.1103/br97-fw3p.note_zh: 双团选民模型区分快速群间对齐与缓慢共识扩散，不对称性可产生中等耦合下的最优点。

10.1103/c44l-89p7.note_en: Heat-kernel curvature characterizes structural transitions in reconstructed infection networks and is compared with alternative network-curvature measures.
10.1103/c44l-89p7.note_zh: 热核曲率刻画重建感染网络中的结构转变，并与其他网络曲率指标比较。

10.1103/c742-lgnc.note_en: Self-propulsion reorganizes one-dimensional swarmalators into traveling clusters and split waves, with long chaotic transients in finite systems.
10.1103/c742-lgnc.note_zh: 自推进使一维群振子重组为旅行簇及分裂波，并在有限系统中产生长混沌暂态。

10.1103/c9vq-tclt.note_zh: 将病原体连续变异与网络传播耦合，分析群体拓扑如何影响传播条件及毒性选择。
10.1103/c9vq-tclt.note_en: Couples continuous pathogen mutation to network spreading to analyze how population topology affects transmission conditions and virulence selection.

10.1103/d26r-r4gp.note_en: Controlled moment closure provides refinable approximate-master-equation solutions for epidemic spreading, voter dynamics and evolutionary games on networks.
10.1103/d26r-r4gp.note_zh: 受控矩闭合为网络疫情传播、选民动力学及演化博弈提供可逐步改进的近似主方程解。

10.1103/d6lk-4f62.note_en: A multiplex articulation-point definition accounts for cascading removal and characterizes fragmentation vulnerability across empirical and random multilayer networks.
10.1103/d6lk-4f62.note_zh: 多层网络割点定义纳入级联移除，刻画实证及随机多层网络的碎裂脆弱性。

10.1103/fltc-hfvt.note_zh: 比较受驱Kuramoto振子链中局域失同步的多种前兆及其参数适用区域。
10.1103/fltc-hfvt.note_en: Compares precursors of solitary decoherence in a driven Kuramoto chain and identifies their parameter-dependent predictive regimes.

10.1103/fsdp-667s.note_en: Inertia and dimensionality parity govern synchronization-transition discontinuity and hysteresis in a generalized multidimensional Kuramoto model.
10.1103/fsdp-667s.note_zh: 惯性及维度奇偶性控制广义多维 Kuramoto 模型中同步转变的不连续性与滞后。

10.1103/ftyk-48y2.note_en: Generator spectra and conductance explain when large Markovian networks develop deterministic or exponential first-passage-time distributions.
10.1103/ftyk-48y2.note_zh: 生成元谱及电导性质解释大型 Markov 网络何时形成确定性或指数首达时间分布。

10.1103/gp7d-fsk5.note_en: Spectral-submanifold reduction predicts aggregate and node-level dynamics near critical transitions in heterogeneous and higher-order nonlinear networks.
10.1103/gp7d-fsk5.note_zh: 谱子流形约化预测异质及高阶非线性网络在临界转变附近的整体和节点动力学。

10.1103/k326-3y4g.note_en: Spatial structure and resource diffusion reshape strategy switching and stability in games with local and global environmental feedback.
10.1103/k326-3y4g.note_zh: 空间结构与资源扩散重塑带局部及全局环境反馈的博弈中的策略切换和稳定性。

10.1103/k9b1-n8mb.note_en: Triadic dispersal interactions produce topology-dependent clustering and synchronization in ecological networks, with stability analyzed through the master stability function.
10.1103/k9b1-n8mb.note_zh: 三体迁移相互作用在生态网络中产生依赖拓扑的聚类与同步，并通过主稳定函数分析稳定性。

10.1103/ktnz-14ft.note_en: Master-stability analysis links nonreciprocal lattice coupling to periodic and quasiperiodic traveling-wave stability and finite-size bounds.
10.1103/ktnz-14ft.note_zh: 主稳定分析将非互易格点耦合与周期及准周期行波的稳定性和有限规模边界联系起来。

10.1103/l51k-63y5.note_en: Parameter-aware reservoirs predict abrupt oscillator-network death transitions and hysteresis, with connectivity inference available when topology is unknown.
10.1103/l51k-63y5.note_zh: 参数感知储备池预测振子网络的突变死亡及滞后，并可在拓扑未知时进行连接推断。

10.1103/m8bw-9fzg.note_en: Information-theoretic analysis compares synaptic learning rules, finding spike-count advantages under low firing rates and sparse plasticity.
10.1103/m8bw-9fzg.note_zh: 信息论分析比较突触学习规则，指出低放电率及稀疏可塑性条件下的脉冲计数优势。

10.1103/m8jf-fjfp.note_zh: 区分可逆胶体网络中的连通渗流、刚性渗流与流变凝胶点，分析连边持久性和观测时标。
10.1103/m8jf-fjfp.note_en: Distinguishes connectivity percolation, rigidity percolation and rheological gelation in reversible colloidal networks across bond lifetimes and observation timescales.

10.1103/n4ps-wmd7.note_en: Fixed-index Hodge spectral tracking detects triangle-deletion vulnerabilities that remain invisible to graph-level connectivity measures.
10.1103/n4ps-wmd7.note_zh: 固定谱索引的 Hodge 跟踪检测三角形删除造成的脆弱性，而图层连通指标可能无法发现。

10.1103/nh3b-1wv5.note_en: Quantum-informed vertex selection augments classical kernelization for maximum independent sets, with an extension to weighted graph problems.
10.1103/nh3b-1wv5.note_zh: 量子信息引导的节点选择扩展最大独立集的经典核化，并可推广到加权图问题。

10.1103/nl7d-16n8.note_en: Closed-form avalanche assembly probabilities connect arbitrary nonnegative coupling matrices to detailed activation patterns in recurrent pulse-coupled networks.
10.1103/nl7d-16n8.note_zh: 雪崩组装概率的闭式表达将任意非负耦合矩阵与递归脉冲耦合网络的详细激活模式联系起来。

10.1103/nvd6-pj1f.note_en: The placement of asymmetric delays reshapes swarmalator collective phases and analytically derived stability boundaries, beyond delay magnitude alone.
10.1103/nvd6-pj1f.note_zh: 非对称时延的作用位置重塑群振子集体相态及解析稳定边界，影响不只来自时延大小。

10.1103/nxwl-5wvf.note_en: Optimal lattice paths develop long-range correlations between selected link times, with direction-dependent statistics associated with first-passage percolation.
10.1103/nxwl-5wvf.note_zh: 最优格点路径中的所选边时间形成长程关联，其方向依赖统计与首达渗流相关。

10.1103/p6qp-2s9f.note_en: Maximum-entropy time-series benchmarks infer signed edges and support assessments of imbalance and community structure in brain networks.
10.1103/p6qp-2s9f.note_zh: 最大熵时间序列基准推断有符号边，支持脑网络不平衡程度及社区结构评估。

10.1103/ppm1-mxhz.note_en: Cross-dimensional random walks rank simplices of different orders and reveal how teleportation affects search on simplicial complexes.
10.1103/ppm1-mxhz.note_zh: 跨维随机游走对不同阶单纯形排序，并揭示瞬移如何影响单纯复形上的搜索。

10.1103/qjl4-wqvx.note_en: A multispecies kinetic theory relates alignment interactions to pattern-forming instabilities, characteristic scales and collective order in active systems.
10.1103/qjl4-wqvx.note_zh: 多物种动理学理论联系对齐相互作用、图样形成失稳、特征尺度及活性系统集体有序。

10.1103/qqwq-7j7j.note_en: Shortest-path layers reduce multidimensional nonlinear network dynamics to estimate the control strength needed for revival from one node.
10.1103/qqwq-7j7j.note_zh: 按最短路分层简化多维非线性网络，估计单节点控制使网络复苏所需的强度。

10.1103/rt96-mb8q.note_en: Canonical maximum-entropy null models enable explicit hypothesis tests of community structure rather than only generic network partitioning.
10.1103/rt96-mb8q.note_zh: 正则最大熵零模型对社区结构进行明确假设检验，而非只给出通用网络划分。

10.1103/s6mj-4f1s.note_en: A phase-encoded reliability formulation models interaction and dependency effects in interconnected systems, illustrated with cascading and interdependent network benchmarks.
10.1103/s6mj-4f1s.note_zh: 相位编码可靠性框架描述互联系统的相互作用与依赖效应，并以级联及互依网络基准说明。

10.1103/sbf3-yfl5.note_en: Finite-range two-dimensional k-core percolation shows continuous or discontinuous transitions, with logarithmic finite-size drift in the first-order regime.
10.1103/sbf3-yfl5.note_zh: 有限作用范围的二维 k-core 渗流呈现连续或不连续转变，一阶区间存在对数有限尺寸漂移。

10.1103/t1sg-qhhf.note_en: Local network growth rules increase shortest-path multiplicity and connect its size scaling to degree distributions and community organization.
10.1103/t1sg-qhhf.note_zh: 局部网络增长规则提高最短路径多重性，并将其规模标度与度分布及社区组织联系起来。

10.1103/tmkq-33c4.note_en: Structural-link and synchronized-path exclusion criteria detect remote synchronization in empirical brain networks and oscillator models, with threshold-dependent results.
10.1103/tmkq-33c4.note_zh: 排除结构连接及同步路径的判据检测实证脑网络与振子模型中的远程同步，结果依赖阈值。

10.1103/tpxk-cltw.note_en: Disordered alignment interactions can promote polar flocking through activity-driven clustering and self-organized neighborhoods with cooperative couplings.
10.1103/tpxk-cltw.note_zh: 无序对齐相互作用可经活动驱动聚集及合作耦合邻域的自组织促进极性集群。

10.1103/tt2n-wll8.note_en: Fourier analysis and statistical classification distinguish chimera states in Dirac-coupled topological signals across different network topologies.
10.1103/tt2n-wll8.note_zh: Fourier 分析与统计分类在不同网络拓扑上识别 Dirac 耦合拓扑信号的奇美拉态。

10.1103/txbw-g9cd.note_zh: 研究有向环网络异质振子的锁频转变、滞后和网络尺寸效应。
10.1103/txbw-g9cd.note_en: Studies frequency-locking transitions, hysteresis and network-size effects in directed rings of heterogeneous oscillators.

10.1103/v1vq-skr1.note_en: Fast adaptation entrains contrarians into synchronized clusters in adaptive networks, requiring a conformist majority and an intermediate coupling window.
10.1103/v1vq-skr1.note_zh: 快速适应使逆从者在自适应网络中形成同步簇，需要从众者占多数及适中的耦合区间。

10.1103/v3jy-fh5p.note_en: Synaptic coarse-tuning constrains population decoding gains, with strong imprecision producing saturation even in recurrent and feedforward network architectures.
10.1103/v3jy-fh5p.note_zh: 突触粗调限制群体解码收益，强不精确性即使在递归及前馈网络架构中也导致饱和。

10.1103/v5cl-krph.note_en: A unified characteristic equation combines distributed delays, noise and periodic coupling to determine oscillator-ensemble incoherence stability.
10.1103/v5cl-krph.note_zh: 统一特征方程结合分布时延、噪声与周期耦合，确定振子群非相干态稳定性。

10.1103/v5zx-93k9.note_zh: 精确推导弹性网络双节点相对坐标的记忆核与回复力；距离坐标约化限于小位移。
10.1103/v5zx-93k9.note_en: Derives exact pair-coordinate memory kernels and restoring forces for elastic networks; distance-coordinate reduction assumes small displacements.

10.1103/v94v-3p18.note_en: Nonlinear coherence feedback and finite-population fluctuations reshape Kuramoto synchronization thresholds, bistability and finite-size scaling.
10.1103/v94v-3p18.note_zh: 非线性相干反馈与有限群体涨落重塑 Kuramoto 同步阈值、双稳态及有限尺寸标度。

10.1103/wfn7-h898.note_en: Random rule-based chemical models connect small-world network organization and growth phase diagrams to autocatalysis and multistationarity.
10.1103/wfn7-h898.note_zh: 随机规则化学模型将小世界网络组织及增长相图与自催化和多稳态联系起来。

10.1103/wwyd-bz8n.note_en: Nonlinear mean-field feedback creates additional steady-state branches, two-step synchronization and hysteresis in a three-dimensional Kuramoto model.
10.1103/wwyd-bz8n.note_zh: 非线性平均场反馈在三维 Kuramoto 模型中产生额外稳态分支、两步同步及滞后。

10.1103/wysx-f9l3.note_en: Forced star oscillator networks support separate explosive and drive-entrained remote synchronization states, depending on forcing strength and stimulus location.
10.1103/wysx-f9l3.note_zh: 受迫星型振子网络支持不同的爆炸式及外驱锁定远程同步态，取决于强迫幅度和刺激位置。

10.1103/x15s-84n9.note_en: Dynamical mean-field analysis relates chaos onset in random recurrent networks to kinetic-energy scaling and stationary neural-activity distributions.
10.1103/x15s-84n9.note_zh: 动力学平均场分析将随机递归网络的混沌起始与动能标度及稳态神经活动分布联系起来。

10.1103/xp24-5rj6.note_en: A mesoscopic theory compares alignment and antialignment copying under annealed and quenched interactions and finite-size fluctuations.
10.1103/xp24-5rj6.note_zh: 介观理论比较退火与淬火的对齐、反对齐复制，分析相互作用组成与有限规模涨落。

10.1103/xsyr-d79f.note_en: Rectangular neighborhood orientation and coordination number alter extended-range bond and site percolation thresholds on square lattices.
10.1103/xsyr-d79f.note_zh: 矩形邻域方向与配位数改变方格上的扩展范围键及位点渗流阈值。

10.1103/xzdr-sh34.note_en: Riemannian multiresolution filtering decomposes time-varying functional connectivity and identifies subnetworks dominating coherent interaction modes across temporal scales.
10.1103/xzdr-sh34.note_zh: Riemann 多分辨率滤波分解时变功能连接，识别在不同时间尺度上主导相干互动模态的子网络。

10.1103/y6ss-j5qv.note_en: Heuristic and exact modularity optimization enforce individual community-size bounds, avoiding indirect size control through a resolution parameter alone.
10.1103/y6ss-j5qv.note_zh: 启发式及精确模块度优化直接约束各社区规模，避免仅通过分辨率参数间接控制。

10.1103/ys6r-4mbf.note_en: Disordered filament polarity and switching transport kinetics create particle localization, strongest at intermediate run lengths in the studied model.
10.1103/ys6r-4mbf.note_zh: 无序丝状结构极性与切换传播动力学产生粒子局域化，在所研究模型中以中等行程长度最强。

10.1103/yz2d-wk6g.note_en: Nonreciprocal flocking exhibits restricted, long-lived chiral transients whose stability depends on density, motility, coupling and finite system size.
10.1103/yz2d-wk6g.note_zh: 非互易集群呈现受限而长寿命的手性暂态，其稳定性依赖密度、运动性、耦合及有限系统规模。

10.1103/znwb-71hy.note_en: Geometric disorder creates hierarchical spin-network couplings that separate local cluster equilibration from much slower global transport relaxation.
10.1103/znwb-71hy.note_zh: 几何无序产生层次自旋网络耦合，使局部团簇平衡与更缓慢的整体传播弛豫分离。

10.1103/43yn-sh6g.note_en: Higher-order orientation statistics alter stick-network percolation thresholds even when the mean orientational order is unchanged.
10.1103/43yn-sh6g.note_zh: 平均取向序参量相同的二维棒接触网络，高阶取向统计仍会改变几何渗流阈值。

10.1063/5.0344726.note_en: Recurrence-based functional networks and graph diffusion distinguish seizure states and reveal state-dependent differences in brain-network organization.
10.1063/5.0344726.note_zh: 结合联合复现功能网络和图扩散识别癫痫状态，并分析不同状态下脑网络组织的差异。

10.1063/5.0354201.note_en: In coevolving strategy and interaction networks, stronger rationality can rescue cooperation that weak selection cannot sustain.
10.1063/5.0354201.note_zh: 在策略与连接共同演化的网络上，增强理性可以恢复弱选择条件下无法维持的合作。

10.1073/pnas.2611888123.note_en: Generalized fluctuation scaling extends Taylor’s law to dependent, heterogeneous heavy-tailed data with infinite moments, including applications to network data.
10.1073/pnas.2611888123.note_zh: 将 Taylor 定律推广到具有依赖性和异质性的无限矩重尾数据，并展示网络数据应用。

10.1063/5.0355932.note_en: Bargaining preferences shape cost sharing and cooperation in snowdrift games, with effects that depend on heterogeneity and network connectivity.
10.1063/5.0355932.note_zh: 在雪堆博弈中，谈判偏好改变成本分担与合作水平；偏好异质性和网络连接度均有影响。

10.1073/pnas.2617622123.note_en: Hillfort visibility and walking-cost networks link terrain to defensive community size and cohesion in the pre-Hispanic Andes.
10.1073/pnas.2617622123.note_zh: 用山堡间可视性与步行成本构建防御网络，分析安第斯地形与社区规模、凝聚性的关系。

10.1038/s42005-026-02894-z.note_en: Face-contact probabilities control granular cluster size, while connected-cluster random-walk statistics remain universal across particle shapes and packing fractions.
10.1038/s42005-026-02894-z.note_zh: 面接触概率控制颗粒连接簇的大小，而簇的随机游走统计在不同颗粒形状和堆积分数下保持普适性。

10.1103/fqfg-ml34.note_en: Graphon operator spectra determine Ising critical temperatures across network topologies, providing tractable models of phase transitions and multistability.
10.1103/fqfg-ml34.note_zh: Graphon 算子谱决定不同网络拓扑上的 Ising 临界温度，为相变和多稳态提供可解析模型。

10.1103/k5hq-js7c.note_zh: 以超边对节点失效比例的容忍阈值描述渐进解体，连接消息传递渗流理论与实证超网络韧性。
10.1103/k5hq-js7c.note_en: A tolerance threshold for failed-node fractions controls hyperedge failure, linking message-passing percolation theory to empirical hypernetwork resilience.

10.1103/t3zw-cs6c.note_en: Strategy and payoff-parameter coevolution on a square lattice produces cooperative or defective states, with rare mutations benefiting cooperation.
10.1103/t3zw-cs6c.note_zh: 方格交互网络上的策略与收益参数共同演化产生合作或背叛状态；稀少突变有利于合作态收益增长。

10.1103/y353-z8sb.note_en: Phase lags in higher-order oscillator communities generate oscillatory or chaotic synchronization and multistability, captured by a reduced macroscopic model.
10.1103/y353-z8sb.note_zh: 高阶耦合振子社区中的相位迟滞可诱发振荡、混沌同步与多稳态，并可用低维宏观模型描述。

10.1103/c8kc-rklj.note_en: A nonequilibrium flow-design framework incorporates Markov-network topology and cost–benefit trade-offs to optimize molecular motors, proofreading and enzyme inhibition.
10.1103/c8kc-rklj.note_zh: 将 Markov 网络拓扑和成本收益权衡纳入非平衡流设计，用于分子马达、校对机制和酶抑制优化。

10.1103/32qy-2v16.note_en: Twisted graph-cycle matrices describe steady-state current fluctuations under finite affinity and reveal a noise transition in a Brownian computation model.
10.1103/32qy-2v16.note_zh: 通过扭曲图环矩阵刻画有限热力学力下的稳态电流涨落，并揭示布朗计算模型中的噪声转变。

10.1103/47l4-6jn5.note_en: Graphicality phase diagrams identify when power-law and double-power-law degree sequences can form simple graphs, including distinct failure mechanisms.
10.1103/47l4-6jn5.note_zh: 给出幂律和双幂律度序列的可图性相图，辨析其无法形成简单图的不同机制。

10.1103/6jqp-bz2r.note_en: Temporal clique graphs permit a piecewise mean-field SIS solution and prevalence approximations tested on random-walker-induced contact networks.
10.1103/6jqp-bz2r.note_zh: 对时变团接触网络推导分段平均场 SIS 解，并在随机游走诱导网络上检验感染率近似。

10.1103/cbwg-5nw6.note_en: An information-transmission model estimates how single-gene knock-ins could restore information in aged regulatory networks, using mouse muscle expression data.
10.1103/cbwg-5nw6.note_zh: 利用小鼠肌肉表达数据和信息传输模型，估计单基因外源表达如何恢复老化调控网络中的信息。

10.1103/kwr4-pzn2.note_en: Environmental responses and competition can cancel in equal-time abundance correlations, limiting ecological interaction inference without additional mechanistic information.
10.1103/kwr4-pzn2.note_zh: 环境响应与竞争效应可在等时丰度相关中相互抵消，提示生态相互作用推断需要额外的机制信息。

10.1103/m57p-97jv.note_zh: 用相互作用图的Laplacian本征模重建冻结自旋构型，联系谱几何、中尺度有序和初态记忆。
10.1103/m57p-97jv.note_en: Uses interaction-graph Laplacian eigenmodes to reconstruct frozen spin configurations and relate spectral geometry to mesoscopic order and initial-state memory.

10.1103/nl4b-7sfq.note_zh: 以首达时间方法解析有噪声QIF神经元群体，连接宏观状态与电、化学突触的相互作用。
10.1103/nl4b-7sfq.note_en: First-passage-based analysis of noisy QIF populations connects macroscopic states with interacting electrical and chemical synapses.

10.1103/zrk4-g7fj.note_en: Nonlinear behavioral feedback creates intervention-abandonment thresholds and epidemic oscillations, with robustness checks in networked populations.
10.1103/zrk4-g7fj.note_zh: 行为与传播的非线性反馈产生防护放弃阈值和周期性疫情，并在网络种群中检验稳健性。

10.1103/qftv-sbqs.note_en: Spectral formulas give first-encounter times for simultaneously resetting network walkers and identify when resetting improves collective search.
10.1103/qftv-sbqs.note_zh: 推导同步重置网络随机行者的首遇时间谱公式，并给出重置能够改善集体搜索的判据。

10.1103/qnhv-yp69.note_en: Monte Carlo simulations map geometric scaling and logarithmic corrections in long-range loop-erased random walks across spatial dimensions.
10.1103/qnhv-yp69.note_zh: 通过 Monte Carlo 模拟分析长程消圈随机游走在不同空间维度中的几何标度、对数修正与长短程交叉。

10.1103/25qf-sfsw.note_en: Graph-based replicator dynamics yield defection-spreading timescales, connecting cooperation collapse to node degree, degree heterogeneity and network spectra.
10.1103/25qf-sfsw.note_zh: 基于图上的复制动力学刻画背叛传播时间，将合作崩溃与节点度、度异质性及网络谱联系起来。

10.1103/3cct-tlk7.note_zh: 连接时延和频率分布共同控制自适应振子网络的成核同步，集体坐标理论刻画双簇态边界。
10.1103/3cct-tlk7.note_en: Connection delays and frequency distributions govern nucleation of synchronization in adaptive oscillator networks; collective coordinates bound two-cluster states.

10.1073/pnas.2620995123.note_en: A rat nervous-system model relates hierarchical modules and rich-club integration to the spread of local connectivity perturbations.
10.1073/pnas.2620995123.note_zh: 大鼠神经系统的加权有向模型连接层级模块、富俱乐部整合与局部连接扰动的传播。

10.1103/mnvf-tq6g.note_en: A Bayesian analysis tracks weakening lagged-correlation connectivity among climate tipping elements under stronger forcing; the inferred links do not establish causation.
10.1103/mnvf-tq6g.note_zh: 贝叶斯分析刻画较强外部强迫下气候临界要素的滞后相关连接减弱；相关边不代表因果作用。

10.1103/m6s5-r1cq.note_zh: 局部双队列闸控改善周期流入下的路由和拥堵转变，具有向运输网络与数据包队列迁移的价值。
10.1103/m6s5-r1cq.note_en: Local two-queue gate control improves routing and smooths jamming transitions under periodic inflow, with transferable use in transport and packet-routing systems.

10.1073/pnas.2601203123.note_en: Human and rat functional networks show shared hippocampal hub organization during approach–avoidance conflict, alongside topology differences associated with behavior and sex.
10.1073/pnas.2601203123.note_zh: 人鼠趋避冲突任务的功能网络呈现共同的海马枢纽组织，并报告与行为及性别相关的拓扑差异。

10.1038/s41467-026-77850-0.note_en: During bacterial adaptation, a metabolite shifts from the periphery to a connector between correlation-network clusters, revealing system-level metabolic reorganization.
10.1038/s41467-026-77850-0.note_zh: 细菌适应过程中，代谢物从相关网络外围转为簇间连接者，揭示系统层面的代谢网络重组。

10.1103/vxkg-41kp.note_en: Editor-selected reading: a multilayer rumor model examines media interventions and social reinforcement; its abstract does not specify contact topology or establish intervention causality.
10.1103/vxkg-41kp.note_zh: 编辑选定相关阅读：多层谣言模型分析媒体干预与社会强化；摘要未明确接触拓扑，也未证明干预因果效果。

10.1063/5.0340752.note_en: Obstacles and coupling shape spiral-wave propagation and interlayer synchronization in bilayer memristive neuronal media.
10.1063/5.0340752.note_zh: 障碍与耦合如何改变双层忆阻神经元系统中的螺旋波传播和层间同步？

10.1063/5.0355263.note_en: Climate networks reveal opposite seasonal changes in Arctic circulation and temperature connectivity within a common quantitative framework.
10.1063/5.0355263.note_zh: 气候网络揭示北极环流与温度连通组织在冬夏之间呈相反变化。

10.1073/pnas.2538056123.note_en: Recurrent regulatory motifs combine into hypermotif circuits whose wiring links developmental architecture to emergent dynamics.
10.1073/pnas.2538056123.note_zh: 发育调控网络中的重复模体组合为超模体，将调控架构与涌现动力学联系起来。

10.1073/pnas.2538060123.note_en: Intercellular hypermotif topologies connect regulatory loops and generate oscillatory or antagonistic morphogen responses in dynamical models.
10.1073/pnas.2538060123.note_zh: 跨细胞超模体连接调控回路，其拓扑可在动力学模型中产生振荡或拮抗的形态发生信号响应。

10.1103/p2cj-1kkl.note_en: Finite-memory gate sequences control operator transport, scrambling and persistent correlations across qubit networks, using graph cover time.
10.1103/p2cj-1kkl.note_zh: 有限记忆门序列借助图覆盖时间分析，调控量子比特网络上的算符输运、混洗及持续相关。

10.1103/pngx-s5xx.note_en: Information-theoretic signatures distinguish higher-order contagion mechanisms from cross-order behaviors; synergy best identifies mechanism order among tested measures.
10.1103/pngx-s5xx.note_zh: 信息论指标区分高阶传播机制与跨阶行为；在所比较指标中，协同信息最可靠地识别机制所在阶数。

10.1063/5.0353880.note_en: Continuation and full-network Floquet analysis distinguish the formation and destabilization routes of breathing and rotobreathing cyclops states.
10.1063/5.0353880.note_zh: 轨道延拓与全网络 Floquet 分析区分呼吸和旋转呼吸 cyclops 态的形成与失稳路径。

10.1103/nlkq-191r.note_zh: 边 qudit 量子图架构以线图表示提升图结构可区分性，并给出超越节点 1-WL 上限的表达能力条件。
10.1103/nlkq-191r.note_en: An edge-qudit quantum graph architecture improves structural distinguishability via line-graph representations beyond node-based 1-WL limits.

10.1103/ycf8-4sz5.note_en: Bubbling criteria compare synchronization thresholds for coupled chaotic oscillators under small heterogeneity and noise.
10.1103/ycf8-4sz5.note_zh: 比较小异质性和噪声引发 bubbling 时，耦合混沌振子的同步阈值判据。

10.1103/yvh4-8yxx.note_en: Long-range vigilance cascades and layer alignment change cooperation thresholds in multiplex networks with different topologies.
10.1103/yvh4-8yxx.note_zh: 长程警觉传播与层间对齐改变不同拓扑多层网络中的合作阈值。

10.1073/pnas.2612387123.note_en: Selective sparse connections pair opposite frequency detunings to synchronize disordered laser networks with a reduced coupling budget.
10.1073/pnas.2612387123.note_zh: 选择性稀疏连接优先配对相反频率失谐，以更少耦合预算同步无序激光网络。

10.1038/d41586-026-03105-z.note_en: A conceptual accounting framework links energy, computation, data and settlement dependencies to stress-test supply-chain disruptions.
10.1038/d41586-026-03105-z.note_zh: 概念性统计框架连接能源、算力、数据与结算依赖，用于供应链中断的压力测试。

10.1103/76kb-hyp4.note_en: Compares maximum-entropy models and gradient boosting for missing-link prediction under matched observable information.
10.1103/76kb-hyp4.note_zh: 在对齐可观测信息的条件下，比较最大熵网络模型与梯度提升的缺失边预测表现。

10.1063/5.0348978.note_en: Entropy-derived weights combine local, semilocal and global structure to rank influential nodes, tested through SIR spreading.
10.1063/5.0348978.note_zh: 以熵权融合局部、半局部与全局结构识别重要节点，并用 SIR 传播检验影响力。

10.1103/y4cy-9l8m.note_zh: 群体节点星网络中，适中内部同步支持叶节点远程同步，过强内部耦合反而触发突变瓦解。
10.1103/y4cy-9l8m.note_en: In star networks of oscillator populations, intermediate internal coherence supports remote leaf synchronization, whereas stronger internal coupling triggers abrupt breakdown.

10.1103/kj33-q69c.note_zh: 耦合代理排队模型出现吸收转变，有限注意力的网络扩展预测临界度与枢纽失效。
10.1103/kj33-q69c.note_en: Coupled-agent queues exhibit an absorbing transition; limited-attention network extensions predict critical degree and hub failure.

10.1103/m3bb-1nhk.note_zh: 含耗散的分枝过程刻画网络沙堆雪崩；强聚类和树结构揭示独立分枝近似的适用边界。
10.1103/m3bb-1nhk.note_en: Dissipative branching processes describe network sandpile avalanches, while strong clustering and tree structure expose limits of independent branching.

10.1038/s41467-026-78293-3.note_en: An interpretable commuting-flow model incorporates informality and economic complexity, with comparisons across four cities.
10.1038/s41467-026-78293-3.note_zh: 可解释通勤流模型纳入非正规就业与经济复杂度，通过四城市比较分析可达性差异。

10.1103/mwny-nmf1.note_en: A solvable swarmalator normal form connects collective-state stability, cusp structure and nonmonotonic synchronization.
10.1103/mwny-nmf1.note_zh: 可解 swarmalator 正规形联系集体态稳定性、尖点结构与非单调同步。

10.1038/s41586-026-11144-9.note_en: Neural recordings and recurrent ring models explain how dynamic decoupling permits rapid attractor-memory writing and switching.
10.1038/s41586-026-11144-9.note_zh: 神经记录与递归环网络模型解释动态解耦如何实现吸引子记忆的快速写入与切换。

10.1038/s41567-026-03408-y.note_en: Geometric and rigidity percolation link connected vorticity structures and vortex-centre networks to the onset of fully developed active turbulence.
10.1038/s41567-026-03408-y.note_zh: 用几何渗流和刚性渗流刻画活性湍流起点，将涡量零线的贯通与涡心网络的力学刚性联系起来。

10.1038/s42005-026-02899-8.note_en: Social comparison of neighbors’ payoffs changes weak-selection cooperation thresholds and the role of network heterogeneity.
10.1038/s42005-026-02899-8.note_zh: 将邻居收益的社会比较纳入适应度，分析弱选择下的合作阈值与网络异质性的作用。

10.1073/pnas.2602161123.note_en: Free-energy constraints on spiking populations yield sparse control and responses robust to internal perturbations.
10.1073/pnas.2602161123.note_zh: 以自由能约束脉冲神经群体，研究稀疏控制及其对内部扰动的鲁棒性。

10.1103/366d-8m6s.note_en: Static maximum-entropy signatures distinguish subcritical activity but can confuse avalanche criticality with supercritical neural dynamics.
10.1103/366d-8m6s.note_zh: 静态最大熵信号能识别亚临界活动，但可能混淆神经雪崩的临界与超临界动力学。

10.1073/pnas.2602244123.note_en: A Perspective on extracting species interactions from multilingual observation comments, with validation and bias checks for ecological network data.
10.1073/pnas.2602244123.note_zh: 介绍从多语言观测评论提取物种相互作用的流程，关注生态网络数据的验证与偏差。

10.1073/pnas.2602630123.note_en: Generative modeling and linearized perturbation responses support causal gene-network inference under explicit identifiability assumptions.
10.1073/pnas.2602630123.note_zh: 结合生成模型与扰动响应线性化推断基因调控因果关系，并明确其可识别性假设。

10.1038/s41467-026-78228-y.note_en: LLM-agent interactions generate social organization and polarization, with interventions tested in the synthetic network system.
10.1038/s41467-026-78228-y.note_zh: 研究 LLM 代理互动形成的社会组织与意见极化，并在合成网络中检验干预。

10.1103/hs2n-6rsn.note_zh: 有向扩展范围渗流中，非互惠方向抑制回溯并简化消息传递；临界行为依赖度关联。
10.1103/hs2n-6rsn.note_en: Nonreciprocal directionality suppresses backtracking and simplifies message passing in directed extended-range percolation, with correlation-dependent critical behavior.

10.1073/pnas.2619598123.note_en: Spatial structure and environmental noise can stabilize competing ecological interaction communities through effective self-regulation.
10.1073/pnas.2619598123.note_zh: 研究空间结构与环境噪声通过有效自调节稳定竞争生态交互群落的机制。

10.1103/hyp9-zngr.note_en: Persistence probabilities reveal phase structure in biased q-voter models and its relation to fixed-point behavior.
10.1103/hyp9-zngr.note_zh: 用持续概率刻画偏置 q-voter 模型的相结构，并分析其与固定点行为的关系。

10.1038/s41467-026-77672-0.note_en: A community-centric citation model connects shared patterns and delayed recognition across science, law and patents.
10.1038/s41467-026-77672-0.note_zh: 社区中心引文模型联系科学、法律与专利的共同引文模式及延迟认可。

10.1103/hh4n-pw7w.note_en: Hydraulic coupling changes fluidic hysterons from independent memory elements into networks with configuration-dependent switching.
10.1103/hh4n-pw7w.note_zh: 水力耦合使流体迟滞元件形成相互作用网络，揭示切换阈值与集体记忆如何依赖系统状态。

10.1063/5.0350660.note_en: Laplacian-spectrum-derived matrices reveal hidden synchronization clusters and connect their visibility to dynamical stability.
10.1063/5.0350660.note_zh: 利用拉普拉斯谱矩阵识别隐藏同步簇，并分析动力学稳定性如何决定这些簇能否显现。

10.1073/pnas.2606245123.note_en: Local synaptic plasticity self-assembles learning motifs whose hierarchical networks approximate gradient learning.
10.1073/pnas.2606245123.note_zh: 局部突触可塑性从随机连接自组装学习模体，使层级网络涌现近似梯度学习。

10.1126/sciadv.adz4710.note_en: Clique-based coarse-graining connects network compression to contagion fidelity and tests the resulting multiscale intervention strategies.
10.1126/sciadv.adz4710.note_zh: 以团为单元粗粒化网络，分析传播保真与压缩程度的折中，并检验多尺度干预策略。

10.1103/52n3-kwdj.note_en: A throughput-based proto-immunity framework analyzes defense motifs and invasion stability in open chemical reaction networks.
10.1103/52n3-kwdj.note_zh: 以通量保护定义开放化学反应网络的原免疫能力，分析防御模体与入侵稳定性。

10.1126/sciadv.aee5886.note_en: Pattern-agnostic analysis reveals unbalanced mesoscale organization and differences across scales in empirical signed networks.
10.1126/sciadv.aee5886.note_zh: 不预设社会平衡模式，识别实证有符号网络的不平衡介观组织及跨尺度结构差异。

10.1038/s42005-026-02914-y.note_en: Cycle holonomy connects local phase mismatch, Laplacian zero modes and global synchronization compatibility.
10.1038/s42005-026-02914-y.note_zh: 从图上循环holonomy连接局部相位失配、拉普拉斯零模与同步兼容性。

10.1073/pnas.2532121123.note_en: Cattle transactions reveal indirect-path evasion after sanctions and vulnerabilities of downstream-only supply-chain enforcement.
10.1073/pnas.2532121123.note_zh: 从牛交易记录识别制裁后的间接路径绕行，揭示仅监管下游的供应链漏洞。

10.1038/s41467-026-78115-6.note_en: Aggregate location and regional flows inform sparse air-mobility reconstruction, evaluated through topology and epidemic dynamics.
10.1038/s41467-026-78115-6.note_zh: 用节点与区域汇总流量构造稀疏航空网络，并以传播动力学检验重建质量。

10.1073/pnas.2610400123.note_en: Heterochronous connection growth improves generative connectome models by jointly fitting topology and spatial layout.
10.1073/pnas.2610400123.note_zh: 在生成模型中加入不同脑区的连接形成时序，同时改进拓扑与空间布局拟合。

10.1063/5.0347841.note_en: Local investor interactions and cross-asset coupling generate multifractality and cross-correlations near collective synchronization balance.
10.1063/5.0347841.note_zh: 局部投资者相互作用与跨资产耦合，在集体同步平衡附近产生多重分形及交叉相关。

10.1103/g8rc-615y.note_en: A force–rate Jacobian and fluctuation–response duality connect local transition-rate changes to global stochastic network-flow control.
10.1103/g8rc-615y.note_zh: 用力–速率Jacobian和涨落响应，连接局部跃迁速率调节与全局随机网络流控制。

10.1103/g7f3-85bn.note_zh: 研究模块化脉冲网络中噪声与耦合控制的记忆检索、滞后和临界样切换。
10.1103/g7f3-85bn.note_en: Studies noise- and coupling-controlled retrieval, hysteresis and critical-like memory switching in modular spiking networks.

10.1063/5.0332769.note_en: Contrasts uniform edge deletion with node-based deletion to derive stationary degree distributions and tail regimes in growing networks.
10.1063/5.0332769.note_zh: 比较均匀边删除与节点驱动边删除，解析生长网络稳态度分布及尾部形态转变。

10.1126/sciadv.ady6737.note_en: Uses long-term mortuary evidence to examine how relational positions and network reorganization shape enduring inequality before states.
10.1126/sciadv.ady6737.note_zh: 以长期墓葬证据考察社会关系网络位置与重组如何形成国家出现前的持久不平等。

10.1063/5.0356660.note_en: Competitive SIS spreading on a two-community simplicial complex links higher-order reinforcement and sentinel intervention to persistence, invasion and hysteresis.
10.1063/5.0356660.note_zh: 两社区单纯复形中的竞争SIS传播，揭示高阶强化与哨兵干预如何改变局域持续、侵入和滞回。

10.1103/tr4w-yrs1.note_en: Tests how noise spectral color changes stationarity and distribution of collective power-grid frequency responses, including topology robustness.
10.1103/tr4w-yrs1.note_zh: 检验噪声谱色怎样改变电网集体频率响应的平稳性与分布，并核验拓扑稳健性。

10.1126/sciadv.aed2474.note_en: Combines respiratory-circuit perturbations and a generative dynamical model to explain rhythm control through transient stabilization of an expiration attractor.
10.1126/sciadv.aed2474.note_zh: 结合呼吸回路干预与生成动力学模型，解释抑制输入通过暂时稳定呼气吸引区控制网络节律。

10.1103/w3lf-h7nt.note_zh: 条纹熔化中的细丝连接网络经历有限簇与贯通网络的密度选择，图观测量揭示连接重组。
10.1103/w3lf-h7nt.note_en: Graph observables reveal density-selected transitions between finite clusters and spanning networks as single-particle-thick stripes melt.

10.1103/wlyc-rtgs.note_en: Derives conditions for hard selection to promote cooperation and fixation in deme-structured populations undergoing growth, merging and dilution.
10.1103/wlyc-rtgs.note_zh: 解析生长、合并与稀释的团体结构种群中，硬选择促进合作和固定的条件。

10.1126/sciadv.aed7447.note_en: Uses focal photostimulation and spike timing to identify electrical-synapse strengths and map thalamic and cortical coupling networks.
10.1126/sciadv.aed7447.note_zh: 以局部光刺激与放电时序识别电突触强度，重建丘脑及皮层电耦合网络。

10.1126/sciadv.aee5162.note_en: Reconstructs Uruk transport-network evolution from dendritic rivers to modules and long-range shortcuts, explaining small-world organization and reduced broker dependence.
10.1126/sciadv.aee5162.note_zh: 重建Uruk运输网络从河流树形结构到模块与长距捷径的演化，解释小世界组织与中间人依赖下降。

10.1103/rvlj-fmf9.note_en: Nested hyperedges advance collective onset while internal pathway redundancy suppresses bistability and explosive transitions.
10.1103/rvlj-fmf9.note_zh: 嵌套超边使集体行为更早启动，但内部通路冗余削弱双稳态和爆炸式转变。

10.1038/s41586-026-11154-7.note_en: Randomized health education reveals dosage-dependent formation, persistence and dissolution of village ties despite stable aggregate degree distributions.
10.1038/s41586-026-11154-7.note_zh: 随机健康教育干预揭示覆盖剂量如何改变村落关系的形成、维持与断裂；总体度分布稳定仍可掩盖重连。

10.1038/s41467-026-78449-1.note_en: Combines longitudinal strain genomes and household locations to infer community and rural–urban transmission links, without treating similarity as proven directional transmission.
10.1038/s41467-026-78449-1.note_zh: 结合纵向菌株基因组与住户位置推断社区及城乡传播联系；不将相近菌株视为已证实的方向性传播。

10.1063/5.0315156.note_zh: 排斥耦合与频率失配使四振子网络出现稳定或切换同步簇，并产生慢快节律与双稳态。
10.1063/5.0315156.note_en: Repulsive coupling and frequency mismatch produce stationary or switching clusters, slow–fast rhythms and bistability in a four-oscillator network.

10.1063/5.0333267.note_zh: 用不变分布刻画随机电网的相角与电压波动，识别稳定性权衡并优化安全集保持概率。
10.1063/5.0333267.note_en: An invariant distribution characterizes phase and voltage fluctuations in stochastic power grids, exposing stability trade-offs and supporting safe-set optimization.

10.1103/n87d-5krk.note_zh: 连接组耦合使局部与全局脑临界性相互影响却不直接对齐，并组织异质时间尺度与临界性梯度。
10.1103/n87d-5krk.note_en: Connectome coupling links local and global critical brain dynamics while organizing heterogeneous timescales and criticality gradients.

10.1103/ssn3-44gk.note_zh: 时间尺度与丰度分离使有限闭合化学反应网络涌现开放网络热力学，并限定该近似的适用时间。
10.1103/ssn3-44gk.note_en: Timescale and abundance separation make open-network thermodynamics emerge within finite closed reaction networks, with a bounded approximation timescale.

10.1063/5.0355934.note_zh: 这篇Perspective将序模式转移网络联系到符号储备池，借兼容历史状态、遍历性与谱隙解释记忆及一步预测。
10.1063/5.0355934.note_en: This Perspective connects ordinal-pattern transition networks to symbolic reservoirs through compatibility-history states, ergodicity, spectral gaps and illustrative one-step predictions.

10.1103/s1kf-3dvn.note_zh: 推导二部网络自洽指标的迭代收敛判据，并借助问题节点处理及非均匀正则化改善收敛。
10.1103/s1kf-3dvn.note_en: An explicit convergence criterion for self-consistent bipartite-network measures guides problematic-node treatment and nonhomogeneous regularization.

10.1073/pnas.2617358123.note_zh: 多站点横断面数据揭示ASD功能连接的两类年龄差异模式及其皮层层级组织，不代表个体纵向变化。
10.1073/pnas.2617358123.note_en: Multisite cross-sectional data reveal two age-related functional-connectivity profiles in autism and their cortical hierarchy, without establishing individual longitudinal change.

10.1073/pnas.2618402123.note_zh: 可疑论文的偏向互引与阅读量差异揭示潜在引文指标扭曲；互引信号本身不等同于已证实的造假。
10.1073/pnas.2618402123.note_en: Preferential mutual citations and readership differences among suspected paper-mill articles reveal potential metric distortion; citation signals alone do not prove fraud.

10.1038/s41467-026-78597-4.note_zh: 全脑同步记录揭示由主动搜索和被动感知策略主导的交替功能子网络，提示解释任务网络时须控制内部策略。
10.1038/s41467-026-78597-4.note_en: Brain-wide recordings reveal alternating functional subnetworks dominated by active-search and passive-sensation strategies, highlighting internal strategy as a task-network confound.

10.1063/5.0356075.note_zh: 策略相似性形成动态交互结构，与适度探索共同维持合作，为自适应网络上的演化博弈提供机制解释。
10.1063/5.0356075.note_en: Similarity-dependent interactions form a dynamic structure that, together with moderate exploration, supports cooperation in an evolving population.

10.1073/pnas.2532180123.note_zh: 将降雨场耦合铁路网络的延误生成、传播与吸收，研究模型临界态和局部扰动风险；真实数据未达到模型崩溃条件。
10.1073/pnas.2532180123.note_en: Couples rainfall to delay generation, propagation and absorption on railway networks, studying model critical regimes and local-shock risk; observed data do not reach model collapse.

10.1103/mzgk-nx4w.note_zh: 局部交互半径调控移动相位振子的涡旋、极化和失稳阈值，揭示空间耦合范围对集体态的影响。
10.1103/mzgk-nx4w.note_en: Local interaction radius controls vortex states, polarization and instability thresholds in mobile phase oscillators, linking spatial coupling range to collective order.

10.1038/s41467-026-78441-9.note_zh: 以多组学先验约束伪时间上的多尺度基因调控网络重构，再用张量分解识别协同调控模块；推断边与滞后不等同于确证因果或真实时间延迟。
10.1038/s41467-026-78441-9.note_en: Constrains multiscale gene regulatory network inference with multiomic priors and decomposes pseudotime-lag tensors into cooperative modules; inferred edges and lags do not establish causal effects or chronological delays.

10.1038/s42256-026-01311-y.note_zh: 研究多样本约束网络推断的稳健性，比较先验、样本和正则化的影响；结构稳定不等于生物因果真值。
10.1038/s42256-026-01311-y.note_en: Studies robustness in multi-sample constrained network inference under changing priors, samples and regularization; structural stability does not establish biological causal truth.

10.1103/1fr3-bbxr.note_zh: 考察乘积规则加边如何影响三维格点网络的连通和刚性；区分有限尺寸跃变与作者讨论的连续极限。
10.1103/1fr3-bbxr.note_en: Examines product-rule connectivity and rigidity in cubic lattice networks, distinguishing finite-size jumps from the continuous limit discussed by the authors.

10.1038/s41467-026-78269-3.note_zh: 将强化学习拆解策略符号化，提炼结合拓扑与节点动力学状态的韧性公式。
10.1038/s41467-026-78269-3.note_en: Symbolizes reinforcement-learning dismantling policies to derive resilience formulas combining topology and node dynamical states.

10.1073/pnas.2611539123.note_zh: 比较野外与实验室转录网络的模块保守和重组，考察环境复杂度下生物响应网络的组织。
10.1073/pnas.2611539123.note_en: Compares conserved and reorganized transcriptomic modules in wild and laboratory plants to examine biotic-response network organization.

10.1038/s42005-026-02864-5.note_zh: 统一刻画圈内多人协同与跨圈多源确认，揭示结构多样性如何改变传播相变、滞后及稳态规模。
10.1038/s42005-026-02864-5.note_en: Unifies within-circle synergy and cross-circle reinforcement to explain transition order, hysteresis and prevalence under structural diversity.

10.1038/s42005-026-02933-9.note_zh: 连接Vicsek粒子的时变相互作用结构、簇统计与宏观极化，定量解释结构演化和集体有序的耦合。
10.1038/s42005-026-02933-9.note_en: Links time-varying interaction structure and cluster statistics to macroscopic polarization in the original Vicsek model.

10.1103/mk9z-q1m3.note_zh: 在独立源量子网络中用可分测量认证全网非局域性，并量化可提取的设备无关随机性。
10.1103/mk9z-q1m3.note_en: Uses separable measurements to certify full nonlocality and device-independent randomness across an independent-source quantum network.

10.1103/8nxh-kpt8.note_zh: 自适应相位挫折的反馈把连续同步转变改造成伴随双稳态与滞后的突变。
10.1103/8nxh-kpt8.note_en: Adaptive phase-frustration feedback turns continuous synchronization into a bistable, hysteretic transition.

10.1103/n8xm-bm44.note_zh: 在相同二体骨架与三体数量下，高阶连接组织及谱对齐控制振荡死亡和多稳态吸引域。
10.1103/n8xm-bm44.note_en: Higher-order organization and spectral alignment control oscillation death and multistability on a fixed pairwise backbone.

10.1073/pnas.2607793123.note_zh: 结合系统发育与互作实验，追踪共生GRAS调控网络因基因保留、丢失和蛋白互作重连而演化。
10.1073/pnas.2607793123.note_en: Traces symbiotic GRAS regulatory-network evolution through gene retention, loss and protein-interaction rewiring across land plants.

10.1103/rghw-4dhl.note_zh: 将分层梳状聚合物的连接图谱与构象、松弛及流变标度联系起来，给出拓扑控制的普适关系。
10.1103/rghw-4dhl.note_en: Connects hierarchical comb topology to polymer conformation, relaxation and rheological scaling through graph spectra.

10.1038/s42005-026-02908-w.note_zh: 研究个体经验学习与邻居模仿的耦合如何改变社会网络上的合作演化。
10.1038/s42005-026-02908-w.note_en: Studies how coupled experience-based learning and neighbor imitation shape cooperation on social networks.

10.1063/5.0352595.note_zh: 从异质扰动稳态推断隐藏相互作用网络，以兼容矩阵秩刻画可辨识性；假定已知动力学与完整节点观测。
10.1063/5.0352595.note_en: Infers hidden interaction networks from perturbed equilibria using rank-based identifiability; assumes known dynamics and fully observed nodes.

10.1103/cknx-xgnj.note_zh: 比较节点删除下的有限尺寸标度和度分布诊断，区分无标度组织不同层次的退化。
10.1103/cknx-xgnj.note_en: Compares finite-size scaling and degree-distribution diagnostics to distinguish levels of scale-free degradation under node removal.

10.1063/5.0357283.note_zh: 结合拓扑、节点状态和采样时间推断 SIR 参数，并比较不同信息缺失及拓扑条件。
10.1063/5.0357283.note_en: Infers SIR parameters from topology, node states and sampling times, comparing missing-information and structural regimes.

10.1103/c9kq-kqbv.note_zh: 建立复杂网络扰动响应的信息热力学，分析标准扩散之外的非线性响应多样性。
10.1103/c9kq-kqbv.note_en: Develops information thermodynamics of network perturbation responses and examines nonlinear response diversity beyond standard diffusion.

10.1103/sk17-8bgv.note_zh: 用贯穿网络的异常短键路径及其共同承载统计解释弹性体首断裂与峰值强度。
10.1103/sk17-8bgv.note_en: Relates elastomer first scission and peak strength to exceptional short spanning paths and their collective load sharing.

10.1103/syk9-5c24.note_zh: 研究 Hebbian 学习、放电适应及抑制如何自组织吸引子连接、前瞻编码和路径积分。
10.1103/syk9-5c24.note_en: Studies self-organization of attractor connectivity, anticipation and path integration through Hebbian learning, firing-rate adaptation and inhibition.

10.1038/s41467-026-78717-0.note_zh: 以图、通道和角色张量联合优化多智能体网络协调，给出压缩梯度流及条件性理论保证。
10.1038/s41467-026-78717-0.note_en: Jointly optimizes graph, channel and role tensors for multi-agent coordination using compressed gradient flow and conditional theoretical guarantees.

10.1038/s41586-026-11175-2.note_zh: 颅内刺激、脑电与连接映射揭示人类岛叶的四区功能组织及非对称有向相互作用。
10.1038/s41586-026-11175-2.note_en: Intracranial stimulation, EEG and connectivity mapping link four insular regions to asymmetric directed electrophysiological interactions.

10.1038/s41586-026-11194-z.note_zh: 干旱与猎物疾病共同触发顶级捕食者间新捕食关系，并可能向较低营养级传递影响。
10.1038/s41586-026-11194-z.note_en: Drought and prey disease jointly trigger a new interaction between top predators, with possible effects at lower trophic levels.

10.1038/s42005-026-02885-0.note_zh: 以节点马尔可夫活跃切换解释时间超图事件间隔与自相关，较长尾不等于渐近幂律。
10.1038/s42005-026-02885-0.note_en: Links Markovian node activity to temporal-hypergraph waiting times and autocorrelation; longer tails do not establish asymptotic power laws.

10.1038/s43588-026-01068-9.note_zh: 以三个结构系数分离动态网络演化博弈中的收益与结构影响；定理限于弱选择及外生马尔可夫切换。
10.1038/s43588-026-01068-9.note_en: Separates payoff and structural effects in dynamic-network games through three coefficients under weak selection and exogenous Markov switching.

10.1103/29cy-4r99.note_zh: 以删边渗流模型连接 dropout 下的输入输出可达性、网络拓扑与训练失效。
10.1103/29cy-4r99.note_en: Links dropout-induced bond percolation, input-output reachability and network topology to training breakdown.

10.1103/29r6-v42s.note_zh: 比较有限维晶格与完全图的强连通簇渗流，刻画分形维数、临界指数与双标度。
10.1103/29r6-v42s.note_en: Characterizes strongly connected cluster percolation on finite-dimensional lattices and complete graphs through fractal dimensions, exponents and double scaling.

10.1038/s41467-026-78154-z.note_zh: 分析肺炎克雷伯菌转录调控网络的层级、跨生长阶段组织与跨菌株保守和演化格局。
10.1038/s41467-026-78154-z.note_en: Analyzes hierarchy, growth-stage organization and cross-strain conservation and evolution in Klebsiella pneumoniae regulatory networks.

10.1103/64b7-qb8p.note_zh: 以分层平均场近似分析抑制神经网络的相变、稳定性及准临界响应。
10.1103/64b7-qb8p.note_en: Uses a hierarchy of mean-field approximations to study phases, stability and quasicritical responses in inhibitory neural networks.

10.1103/8sqq-6mym.note_zh: 以保度随机网络为基线，将同配性扩展至长程、非标量属性和非线性相似关系。
10.1103/8sqq-6mym.note_en: Extends assortativity to long-range, non-scalar and nonlinear similarity using degree-preserving null networks.

10.1073/pnas.2623939123.note_zh: 研究蜜蜂行为成熟中有符号基因相关网络的全局协调与模块分离；相关结构不等同因果调控。
10.1073/pnas.2623939123.note_en: Studies global coordination and modular segregation of signed gene-correlation networks during honeybee maturation; correlations do not establish causal regulation.

10.1038/s41467-026-75827-7.note_zh: 用估计结构与功能连接组识别多发性硬化认知相关脑回路，并检验随访预测。
10.1038/s41467-026-75827-7.note_en: Uses estimated structural and functional connectomes to identify cognition-related circuits in multiple sclerosis and test follow-up prediction.

10.1103/bnzj-r7jy.note_zh: 在分形层级网络上用生成函数和重整化分析刻画位点渗流的临界相变。
10.1103/bnzj-r7jy.note_en: Uses generating functions and renormalization on a fractal hierarchical network to characterize a critical site-percolation transition.

10.1103/ckx2-zbrb.note_zh: 将相互作用强度与物种度关联，分析生态网络中枢纽偏好与生存相变。
10.1103/ckx2-zbrb.note_en: Couples interaction strength to species degree to analyze hub-favored and hub-suppressed viability regimes in ecological networks.

10.1103/pgt1-cs46.note_zh: 在网络 gossip 动力学中加入指定节点重置，给出信息分配的渐近量、收敛速度和置信界。
10.1103/pgt1-cs46.note_en: Adds resetting to network gossip dynamics and derives asymptotic allocation, convergence speed and confidence bounds.

10.1038/s41467-026-78839-5.note_zh: 用自然情境 fMRI 构建白质连接组分区，比较不同通路的认知功能专门化。
10.1038/s41467-026-78839-5.note_en: Builds a functionally grounded white-matter connectome parcellation from naturalistic fMRI and compares pathway specialization.

10.1038/s41467-026-78646-y.note_en: A recommendation-inspired bipartite interaction graph transformer learns sparse chromatin–gene links and regulatory rewiring; biological interpretation remains application-specific.
10.1038/s41467-026-78646-y.note_zh: 以推荐系统为启发的二部交互图 Transformer 学习稀疏染色质—基因联系与调控重连；生物学解释仍限于该应用。

10.1038/s41467-026-78727-y.note_en: Dense associative-memory and Hopfield energy landscapes connect memorization, spurious attractors and diffusion-model generalization; the causal role of spurious states remains unproven.
10.1038/s41467-026-78727-y.note_zh: 将稠密联想记忆与 Hopfield 能量景观联系到扩散模型的记忆化、伪吸引态和泛化；伪状态是否因果驱动泛化仍未证明。

10.1038/s41467-026-79018-2.note_en: Individualized functional brain networks reveal complementary integrity and integration axes in focal epilepsy, with syndrome-specific clinical associations.
10.1038/s41467-026-79018-2.note_zh: 个体化功能脑网络的完整性与整合性轴，在局灶性癫痫中呈现互补且与临床表型相关的变化。

10.1038/s41467-026-79031-5.note_en: Head-direction attractor dynamics recover before locomotion in head-fixed mice; lateral connectivity helps explain context-dependent neural coding.
10.1038/s41467-026-79031-5.note_zh: 头固定小鼠的头向吸引子动力学在运动前恢复；横向连接有助于解释情境依赖的神经编码。

10.1103/5lnm-slgg.note_zh: 以配位团簇的贯通和临界标度描述受压玻璃的非晶转变；高配位网络的刚性渗流解释仍属暂定。
10.1103/5lnm-slgg.note_en: Coordination-cluster connectivity and critical scaling describe transitions in compressed glasses; a rigidity-percolation explanation at high coordination remains tentative.

10.1103/ydgr-vs2w.note_zh: 热力学响应约束与图论 coherence 判据给出复杂反应网络中简单局部反馈的稳定控制条件。
10.1103/ydgr-vs2w.note_en: Thermodynamic response constraints and graph coherence identify stable-control conditions for simple local feedback in complex reaction networks.

10.1073/pnas.2321155123.note_zh: 多参与者微观经济模型追踪食物系统的跨区域冲击传播与分配效应；适于情景理解，非精确政策预测。
10.1073/pnas.2321155123.note_en: A multiplayer microeconomic model traces regional shock propagation and distributional effects in food systems; it supports scenario understanding rather than precise policy prediction.

10.1103/4tf9-n1zn.note_zh: 稠密无序网络上的非平衡稳态占据呈现 Boltzmann-like 分布，低 rattling 渐近规律连接状态逃逸与稳态概率。
10.1103/4tf9-n1zn.note_en: Dense disordered networks show Boltzmann-like occupations in nonequilibrium steady states, linking slow escape and steady-state probability.

10.1073/pnas.2607559123.note_zh: 活动依赖的乘性门控重组联想记忆网络的吸引子，使过载区仍可保持检索并产生连续多稳态。
10.1073/pnas.2607559123.note_en: Activity-dependent multiplicative gating reorganizes associative-memory attractors, extending retrieval beyond the classical capacity transition and creating continuous multistability.

10.1103/y1tc-4ms4.note_zh: GC-KAN 从多变量时间序列稀疏推断预测父节点与滞后响应；这里的 Granger 关系是预测关系，不等同干预因果。
10.1103/y1tc-4ms4.note_en: GC-KAN sparsely infers predictive parents and lag responses from multivariate time series; Granger relations here are predictive, not intervention causal.

10.1073/pnas.2610672123.note_zh: 病毒共享网络显示哺乳动物宿主跨目的异质组织，并联系生态因素与传播中心性。
10.1073/pnas.2610672123.note_en: A viral-sharing network reveals heterogeneous cross-order host structure and links ecological factors to transmission centrality.

10.1038/s41586-026-11195-y.note_zh: 连接组约束的模拟与网络剪枝识别果蝇步行的候选最小节律回路；三神经元必要充分性是模拟结果。
10.1038/s41586-026-11195-y.note_en: Connectome-constrained simulations and pruning identify a putative minimal walking rhythm circuit; the three-neuron necessity and sufficiency result is computational.

10.1103/4vx7-ngvv.note_zh: 以多层表示、随机块模型与 MCMC 推断时序网络的层级核心—边缘结构。
10.1103/4vx7-ngvv.note_en: A multilayer representation, stochastic block models and MCMC infer hierarchical core-periphery structure in temporal networks.

10.1103/dgxp-yq1g.note_zh: 按结构相似性发现节点角色，为机场与合作网络提供区别于社区划分的结构分解。
10.1103/dgxp-yq1g.note_en: Structural-similarity node roles reveal network decompositions that complement community analysis in airport and collaboration networks.

10.1073/pnas.2610932123.note_zh: 控制个体活跃度与层密度，以组成框架比较洪都拉斯村庄多层社会网络的出向与入向角色；横截面关联不代表因果。
10.1073/pnas.2610932123.note_en: A compositional framework controls activity and layer density to compare outgoing and incoming roles in Honduran multiplex village networks; cross-sectional associations are not causal.

10.1103/wf4x-hfmj.note_zh: 模拟二维有向晶格的强连通渗流，比较不同键方向配置的临界行为及其与无向渗流的差别。
10.1103/wf4x-hfmj.note_en: Simulations compare strongly connected percolation across directed square-lattice bond arrangements and distinguish its critical behavior from undirected percolation.
